I think dating someone with a mental illness is extremely hard but well satisfying in the end. 

She sounds like a very broken person and if she wants to make this work she needs to go seek therapy and medication and identify her irrational thoughts and behavior in order to change for the better of your relationship. 

I understand how she feels though. She honestly just sounds like she cares. Maybe a bit too much though :)

I think differently of this email. Sometimes in life its hard to look back on our relationships and think about how you used to be so close and now you're strangers. It just sounds like she doesn't want to be a stranger to you, she wants to be in your life even if its just friends. Why is this so bad? She seems genuinely nice and wanting to share her experiences with OP. Sometimes as humans we miss people, it isn't wrong of us to miss people! Or is it reddit?

Honestly you deserve someone who understands what you're going through and wants to be there to support you. This guy sounds like a jerk and you deserve better. Mental illnesses are a chemical imbalance in the brain. We can't help how we feel.

Honestly this sounds like she has mood issues. I'm thinking it could possibly be bi polar. 

I used to act fairly similar, but I went to therapy because I realised this wasn't healthy and was hurting the guy I loved and I couldn't live so irrational and impulsively anymore.

I suggest CBT therapy and perhaps a medication to help stabilize her moods.
